execution: Manual provider acceptance in an owned test environment; not included in the fixed C01-C50 automated campaign. These steps do not authorize execution.

scenarios.title: Legacy two-service request stored as one hour
prerequisites: Owned disposable test environment with candidate code and prompt
Exact catalogue labels Brake Repair & Pad Replacement (90 min, technician A) and Suspension Repair (Shocks & Struts) (120 min, technician B)
setup: Create a native 60-minute Oil Change appointment in the owned test environment; record request/reservation/provider IDs and the original time.

With the test app stopped, change only that owned request to service_type=Repair, issue_description=Brake Repair & Pad Replacement and Suspension Repair (Shocks & Struts), service_components=NULL; retain 60-minute capacity and no group.
Restart the test app; retain a fresh before snapshot including outbox, audit and calendar events.
scenarios.caller: Ask to reschedule that visit; consent to the proposed time, then ask whether all three and a half hours are reserved.
expected: Tool rejects BOOKING_SERVICE_SCOPE_MISMATCH with recorded 60 and catalogue 210 minutes.
Agent admits the mismatch and offers advisor review without booking it absent consent.
Every original request, reservation, segment, slot, audit row and outbox item remains unchanged.
No new or updated provider event/message. No invented check-in or hidden full reservation.

scenarios.title: Correct specialist visit moves with exact persisted windows
setup: Use the same 90/120-minute specialist catalogue to book both exact labels in one native booking tool request.
Retain linked request/reservation IDs and independently read original Google event IDs/windows.
scenarios.caller: Ask to move the whole visit to an available start; explicitly consent; ask the agent to verify the total and both appointments.
expected: One reschedule mutation; same two linked requests with 90 and 120 minutes and correct technician ownership.
Two receipts match fresh database reservations and complete 15-minute capacity segments; total service duration 210 minutes.
Independent Google read-back shows exactly the two moved windows; old events are removed/reconciled with no duplicates.
Any messages contain the corresponding saved component window. Agent reports only receipt-supported delivery.

scenarios.title: Caller challenges a conflicting duration
setup: Reuse the owned RS01 legacy fixture before mutation.
scenarios.caller: Ask for the saved duration, compare the one-hour notification with the catalogue estimate, and ask Are you sure?
expected: Agent explicitly distinguishes the 210-minute service estimate from the 60 minutes recorded and admits the discrepancy.
No claim of an initial check-in slot or hidden technician reservation. No silent repair, replacement booking or unsolicited callback.
